# Prompt

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Prompt>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)

A concrete prompt presented to a model in an invocation — content-addressable ([`gmeow:contentDigest`](../properties/gmeow-contentDigest.md)), role-tagged ([`gmeow:promptRole`](../properties/gmeow-promptRole.md)), optionally instantiating a template ([`gmeow:filledFrom`](../properties/gmeow-filledFrom.md)). Prompts are provenance: a claim is only auditable when the instruction that elicited it is recorded. The system-prompt-as-persona seam (a prompt enacting a [`gmeow:Persona`](gmeow-Persona.md) with its registers and style guide) is the norms extension's machinery, used from instance data.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
